name: eqty-skills
description: eqty-manifest reads, verifies and reports on EQTY lineage manifests; eqty-instrument makes a repo emit one.

interface.shortDescription: Read, verify and emit EQTY lineage manifests
interface.longDescription: eqty-manifest parses an EQTY lineage manifest and verifies its signatures, content addresses, statement integrity and hardware attestation evidence. eqty-instrument makes a repo emit a manifest, as a patch for a human to review.
defaultPrompt: Instrument this repo to emit an EQTY manifest
